about: Reference values for the ASE bond-polarizability / Placzek-static Raman port. Generated with ASE 3.29.0 + the extended Lippincott-Stutman table from kjappelbaum/ase@polarizability (the fork cheminfo-py/xtbservice, and therefore ir.cheminfo.org, ran). Units: positions A, masses amu, alpha A^3, dAlphaDx A^2, modes amu^-1/2 (cartesian w = L/sqrt(m), sum_q m_q w_q^2 = 1), activity A^4/amu. delta = 0.01 A central difference, bond list rebuilt at every displaced geometry (ASE semantics).
